record.one_liner: Generative image and video model platform (Higgsfield) exposing 50+ image/video models via a pay-as-you-go REST API and an MCP server
record.auth_notes: Credentials are a key ID and secret created in Higgsfield Console, sent in the Authorization header as Key ID:SECRET. No OAuth documented for the API (the MCP server authenticates via the user's Higgsfield account).
record.access_notes: critic: access self_serve_free -> paid_plan. Account and key creation are self-serve, but the API is prepaid only: you must add a payment method and top up a balance (min $5) before generating. Separate from website plans; no free tier or trial credits for the API found.
record.api_notes: Async REST generation endpoints per model (request_id, status_url, cancel_url), plus Python/TS SDKs. Coverage is limited to generation models.
record.blocker_notes: critic: verdict ready -> blocked. Needs prepaid funds (min $5 top-up) with no free/trial path to working API use; no subscription though, so a low-cost barrier. Note mcp uses account auth and website credits.

evidence.quote: Each credential consists of a key ID and a secret.
Billing is pay-as-you-go from a US dollar balance, and the minimum top-up is $5.
Add a payment method and top up your balance.
Add the Higgsfield MCP server URL in your agent's settings and authenticate through your Higgsfield account.
No plan or subscription is involved: fund the balance, send requests at the rates listed in the catalog, and new requests simply wait once the balance hits zero.
